Ko-Luma
Ko-Pala
Pala Akha in Laos

hh_ethnologue_comment.comment:
Luma along with other lects in Phongsaly province in Laos (**hh:hsoc:Shintanietal:Phongxaly**, **hh:w:Kingsadaetal:Ko-Pala**, **hh:hld:Lew:Luma**) are often filed under Akha [ahk], but Luma is not intelligible with Akha [ahk], nor with its closest relative Akeu [aeu], and thus merits its own language entry
(**hh:hld:Lew:Luma**). See also: Akeu [aeu], Akha [ahk].
